mensagens.input: Hair-Be-Gone Hair Salon has a special offer where for every 6 haircuts that a customer pays for at the salon, the customer will receive 2 free bottles of shampoo. If Mandy's mom pays for her family to receive a total of 24 haircuts at Hair-Be-Gone Hair Salon during the course of a year, how many free bottles of shampoo will Mandy's mom receive?
Mandy's mom will receive _____ free bottles of shampoo.
